The '''Croyden system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Croyden [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="TEA" />

In "[[The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 27|twenty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, published in [[1995]], ''[[Star Wars]]'' actor [[Anthony Daniels]] made a tongue-in-cheek reference to "[[Croyden]], the dreadfully boring [[Moon/Legends|sub-moon]] of [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Gipper]]," which he did not recommend visiting. According to Daniels, Croyden had an inefficient postal system and it was the only location where back issues of ''Cantina Cuisine'', a fictitious periodical advertised as part of "The New Wonder Column," where available.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|27|The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column}}</ref>
